segments.text: They called it anger.
I called it fuel.
No leash on the flame.
KTD.
I was raised where a full plate felt like a rumor.
Where the cold made a child learn the face of a tumor.
Where the cold made a child learn the face of a tumor.
Six names in the house, one prayer in the ceiling.
Grandma held the line while the whole world was stealing.
I was twelve with a city trying to turn me to stone.
Trying to carve my worth from a borrowed phone.
They saw black skin first, wrote the verdict before me.
So I wrote back in rhythm, now the scars tell the story.
I ran with the night, yeah, I know what I did.
I was looking for a door when the system kept it hid.
But the street is not a throne, and the system for the head.
I was looking for a door when the system kept it hid.
But the street is not a throne, and the rage is not a god.
I had to face the dragon, had to answer for the odds.
I lost, I learned, I bled, I built.
Turned every locked door into iron will.
If they want the old me, tell them that one quit.
No leash on the flame.
Fuck it, let it hit.
Who are you?
KTD.
What you bring?
The heat.
No leash on the flame.
Unleash the dragon.
If the world says stay down, I say watch what I do.
Unleash the dragon, make the whole sky move.
I left the crime, kept the lessons, took the pressure to the page.
Worked the rooms, learned the cables, turned the cage into a stage.
In need of pilot school to make the knowledge mine.
I read through every failure till the fracture formed a spine.
Mother on the bed, six futures in my hands.
I was building something bigger than a name or a brand.
Every brother got a ladder, every sister got a chance.
Now the family's in the light, and the mission more a brand.
Every brother got a ladder, every sister got a chance.
Now the family's in the light, and the mission's in the stance.
I don't rap for revenge, I rap to break the pattern.
For the kid who hears impossible and still makes it happen.
I don't hide the ugly truth, I put it in the frame.
Then I turn the heat to power, put a purpose on the flame.
Fast tongue, hard drums, let the consonants crack.
I was counted as a problem, now I'm counting this back.
If the crown is only mine, then the crown is counterfeit.
I bring the whole block with me.
Fuck it, let it hit.
Almost let the fire make a home inside my chest.
Then a voice from the old days said, "Son, you still can choose." So I kept the flame alive, but I changed what it could do.
I'm a man who met the monster and taught it how to climb.
Who are you?
KTD.
What you bring?
The heat.
No leash on the flame.
Unleash the dragon.
I came from the dark, now the dark can't tag him.
Who?
KTD.
What you bring?
The truth.
If the world says stay down, I say watch what I do.
Unleash the dragon, make the whole sky move.
No leash.
No leash.
No fear.
No fear.
One voice.
One voice.
KTD, right here.
The dragon did not come to burn the world.
The dragon came to light it.
KTD.
